result.report:
PASS for the stated partial theorem in the declared real-coefficient, finite rational-domain category. The argument establishes the actual envelope and its complete negative contact integral for every reference satisfying the stated recession inequalities. It leaves the original classification open. No external theorem is needed by the reconstructed main proof; the cited sources provide conventions and declared comparisons.

Lemmas 1–5 check out. The compact-section and homogenization arguments establish finite rational generation; elimination establishes projection and cone closedness. The nearest-point separation proof gives the finite support alternative with the correct inequality signs. Lemma 3 obtains its support inequalities from actual rational-endpoint PCCs, then propagates a germ support along carrier segments using nondecreasing slopes. This proves sufficiency for PCCs on other structures and at real centres. Lemma 4 uses the same support form, its equality with the tangential slope, and balancing to establish effectivity for arbitrary nonnegative real local cycles in every positive dimension on ordinary opens. Lemma 5 uses the rational subspace defined by the active constraints and a small rational coordinate box; its positive convex weights reproduce the original reference exactly. The finite recession tests retain strict positivity on every nonzero recession direction.

The divisor algebra is reconstructed without importing Allermann–Rau or extending a source theorem by density. Normal-lift cancellation, refinement compatibility, balancing and commutativity follow from the displayed formulas. The plane-index factor 1/χ is correct. At higher-dimensional tested faces, quotienting by the saturated tangent lattice preserves the relevant lattices and primitive quotient normal classes; this is local algebra, not a pushforward argument. Applying effectivity twice therefore gives a finite nonnegative atomic measure independent of refinement.

All six original tangent planes are saturated: their equations are respectively z=0, y=0, y=z, x=0, x=z and x=y. Every pair lattice is generated by its two displayed rays, since all four triple determinants are ±1. The lifts v_j are primitive inward quotient normals along v_i, and their sum is −v_i. The tangential correction consequently gives original-ray divisor weight 2 for q. The two diagonal weights are also 2. Their q-slopes are zero, while the four original-ray slopes are one, giving q²·[X]=8δ₀ with no factorial division. The circuit and flat calculations correctly identify the unit-weight U₃,₄ carrier.

The gluing construction establishes quantitative exterior growth. The common η and B bound every rational component below by ηρ−B. All maxima involve rational affine pieces and rational constants, so their comparison walls are rational. Taking the exact real-weighted sum introduces no new walls. The construction gives P≥γ, bounded P−γ, P=C+λq on ρ≤2R, and exact P=γ on ρ≥S. It therefore produces a nonnegative compactly supported obstacle on a finite rational complex for every allowed real reference.

The raw-envelope proof establishes both inequalities everywhere. The opposite rational diagonal endpoints force every competitor’s origin value below C. Rational radial PCCs then give the interior bound at rational points. Enclosing rational simplices in affinity faces extend it to arbitrary real centres using real barycentric coefficients, without any continuity assumption on competitors. Outside the roof, the obstacle already equals P. Conversely, P satisfies every competitor condition. The choice ε∈{1,2} correctly ensures the nonzero mixed difference required for nonseparability.

The operator evaluation is unconditional because this envelope is itself PA and PAPC. The sequence P+1/n proves its decreasing uniform regularizability and has the identical recursive measure. No general real regularizable-operator extension or whole-pair regularity is assumed. Recursive locality gives μ=8λ²δ₀ on ρ<2R. The full integrand is −εb_R: its only nonzero mass contribution is at the origin. Every roof-boundary, interpolation-region and exterior atom contributes zero. Thus the complete integral is exactly −8ελ², rather than merely a central-atom estimate.

For γ=ρ, I checked the sector comparison equations, primitive covector gcds, all 22 nonzero first-divisor edges, primitive outgoing directions, and balancing at all nine vertices. The masses are 1/2; 27/8 at each of A₁,A₂,A₃; 11/8 at A₄; 1 at D₊; 5 at D₋; and 3 at each of D₁₄,D₂₄. They sum to 24. Only the origin contributes to contact, giving −1/2. The additional finite arithmetic check corroborates this enumeration; it is not the proof of the universal theorem.

I inspected the authentic [BMPS v1 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.08664v1), including the relevant definitions and the complete Example 6.24/Claim 6.25 proof. Its reference differs from q: its original-ray divisor weights vanish, its exceptional diagonal weights are 2, and its other four diagonal weights are 1, yielding mass 4. Its exceptional zero line prevents positive recession growth. I also retrieved the [frozen book chapter](https://github.com/MingchenXia/nonarchimedean-pluripotential-theory/blob/00957114db21b627e97369563032ceda9cea09c7/manuscript/parts/part6/ch72_major_open_problems.tex) and inspected the full positive-growth obstruction proof. Its special-reference result retains the regularizability alternative. Under its operator hypothesis, locality can be applied using the modified reference in the same growth class, which agrees with the original source reference near the origin. Neither comparison supplies the new actual-envelope or universal-reference conclusion.

Harmless wording corrections: the saturated tangent lattice is introduced in BMPS Definition 2.1; Definitions 2.18–2.20 concern normals, weights and cycles. Clarify that “candidate is false” records the unresolved original classification, not falsity of the displayed partial theorem. No substantive repair to the main proof is required. This verdict makes no PAPC+, higher-dimensional smoothness, literal-category, analytic-realization, unrelated book-theorem, or artifact-certification claim.
